_readme: Model registry for RoadSense AI (task A3-7). This file is the single source of truth for
'which model is current and where do I get it'. Weights are gitignored, so WITHOUT this file
the repo cannot tell you what the model is — that gap already caused two wrong audits and one
Consumers: run `python fetch_model.py` (no arguments) to get the default model, verified by
SHA256. Run `python fetch_model.py --list` to see every version with its real numbers.
Person A: on every release, add an entry here and publish the asset. Never point an entry at
an artifact you have not hashed.

roadsense-yolov8s-v3-merged.trained_on: pothole-detection-3 (1,230) + RDD2022 India + 57 hard negatives = 6,655 images

metrics._note: RDD test-split AP. NOT comparable across runs with different test sets — the real-footage numbers below are the ship gate.

known_weaknesses: Crack class is CONSERVATIVE: AP50 0.499 on RDD's test set, but emits ZERO cracks on potholevideos.mp4 even at conf 0.05. It is pothole-biased (6,358 pothole vs 2,581 crack boxes in training). Not validated on real crack footage.
Never validated from a moving vehicle. All real-footage evidence is handheld pedestrian-height video (potholevideos.mp4). The product is a vehicle-mounted dashcam.
mAP50 >= 0.75 (the Phase-2 target) is NOT met and is likely near-SOTA for multi-class road damage. See experiments.md.
Severity is RELATIVE, not metric. Thresholds are tertiles of one video; SEVERITY_HORIZON_Y must match the camera (0.0 = horizon at/above frame top; a dashcam with a visible skyline needs ~0.5).
